subject: Proposal from risk_analyst
body: Risk assessment for issue #3077 Option C (full remaining scope): overall MEDIUM, PROCEED_WITH_MITIGATIONS. Seven risks, three HIGH-severity but all closable at design time: R1 the artifact-spec module becoming a fourth replica of path knowledge unless each existing hardcoding is explicitly DERIVED or containment-ASSERTED with a CI test; R2 the generalized propose-time validator either bricking legitimate artifact-less proposals (no_changes_needed, sentinel SHAs, dual-role agents) or silently degrading into never-validating — #3081 on both edges — mitigated by an explicit per-(role,condition) degradation matrix with observable skips; R3 the gateway artifact-read endpoint's residual ref-injection/cross-pipeline-scoping surface (HITL Q2's name-only resolution already closes the path dimension) — flagged requires_human_review for the session-binding decision #3002 will inherit. Plus: R4 sync-failure warning must be injected sandbox-side (wrapper), not orchestrator-side event_prompt — the two sides never exchange state and the wrapper is a format-string template; R5 phase-3 prose deletion ordered last + ratchet-test allowlist; R6 spec module must live in shared/egg_contracts or both Dockerfiles need COPY updates (verified both already ship egg_contracts/egg_restrictions); R7 fail-loud durability signal keyed to BRC-on-memory-backend in deployed context, not mere backend selection (auto→memory is the normal dev path; the existing fallback warning has prevented nothing). Grounded against the working tree: consensus_wrapper.py:487-539, signals.py:1067-1200, message_store.py:589-650, phase_filter.py:595-655, both Dockerfiles.

subject: Proposal from architect
body: Architecture for #3077 Option C (HITL-approved full scope), 6-slice DAG. Slice-1: R1 non-silent sync — sync_to_proposals() (consensus_wrapper.py:487-541) records per-SHA outcomes and the wrapper prepends an explicit not-synced banner to the reviewer prompt on failure; event_prompt.py empty-delta caution cross-references it. Slice-2: declarative artifact-spec module at shared/egg_contracts/artifact_spec.py (5-row registry: analysis-draft, plan-draft, architect-output, architect-slices, risk-analyst-output) with MANDATORY consistency tests against gateway/phase_filter.py gates, _get_draft_path, and prompt f-string literals. Slice-3: spec-derived propose-time presence validation for ALL refine/plan producers in signals.py, subsuming _validate_producer_draft_present and the task_planner-only validator; preserves #3081 graceful-degradation; plan keeps parse_plan + role-alignment extensions. Slice-4: strict gateway artifact-read endpoint (HITL Q2: spec-registered names only, path unrepresentable in schema; hex-validated committed refs; contract_api.py forward pattern; new orchestrator/routes/artifacts.py; sandbox helper) — unblocks #3002. Slice-5: REVIEWER-SYNC/event-prompt fetch-prose deletion + docs/architecture invariant entry + no-sync-mechanics ratchet test; last on chain (hard event_prompt.py overlap with slice-1 per #3046, serialized_chain_order recorded). Slice-6: bounded durability per HITL Q3 — fail-loud health-visible flag on auto→memory fallback in message_store.py + Redis restart-semantics test distinguishing the designed _clear_concurrent_state() wipe from accidental loss; parallel root (disjoint files). NOTE for task_planner: this scaffold (#2809) is binding and landed AFTER your 3077-plan.md draft — copy the slices.yaml verbatim into the # yaml-tasks appendix and re-align tasks to the 6-slice chain on your next cycle. All claims carry file:line evidence; runtime-primitive contexts surfaced per #2594.

subject: ACK from risk_analyst for architect
body: Risk review PASS — design satisfies all risk gates from my assessment (v1). R1: spec consistency tests in-slice/blocking (ac-2), literals asserted in slice-2 then derived in slice-3. R2: explicit per-condition degradation matrix (no_changes_needed/RECONSTRUCTED_NO_SHA skip, no-spec roles validate nothing, infra ambiguity degrades non-blocking), existing helper reused without fork, #3081 semantics preserved, per-role tests mandated. R3: strict name-only schema (path unrepresentable per HITL Q2), hex-validated committed refs, session-bound pipeline_id, explicit truncated flag. R4: sync-failure banner is wrapper-side (correct process boundary); orchestrator round-trip explicitly rejected. R5: prose deletion ordered last on chain; ratchet allowlist with per-entry justification. R6: spec in shared/egg_contracts, already shipped in both containers. R7: auto→memory escalates to error+health flag, explicit memory stays warning — consent-based, avoids alert fatigue. Non-blocking notes for implement: (a) slice-3 validation skips should emit an observable log line per skip condition; (b) slice-4 should specify honest 4xx (not 500) when a registered name is absent at the requested ref.

subject: Proposal from task_planner
body: Plan for #3077 (HITL Option C, full remaining scope) on the architect's 6-slice DAG: slices 1-5 serialized, slice 6 parallel root; 17 tasks. Slice 1 — R1 non-silent sync: sync_to_proposals() records per-SHA outcomes (merged/already-ancestor/unresolvable/merge-failed) and the wrapper prepends a "worktree NOT synced" banner to the fetched event prompt on failure; event_prompt empty-delta caution cross-references it. Slice 2 — artifact spec module (shared/egg_contracts/artifact_spec.py: frozen rows for analysis-draft, plan-draft, architect-output, architect-slices, risk-analyst-output; resolve_artifact_path/specs_for/spec_by_name) with MANDATORY in-slice consistency tests pinning phase gates, the phase_patterns mirror, _get_draft_path (both identifier shapes), and pipelines.py prompt literals to the spec; no consumer rewiring yet. Slice 3 — spec-derived propose validation for all refine/plan producers, reusing the #3081 branch_verified graceful-degradation git-show helper, keeping plan parseability/role-alignment extensions, deleting _validate_producer_draft_present, re-deriving the asserted literals. Slice 4 — strict gateway POST /api/v1/artifact/get (gateway/artifact_api.py blueprint forwarding to new orchestrator/routes/artifacts.py; no path field in schema, hex-validated refs, 400 lists registered names, output caps + truncated flag — HITL Q2; unblocks #3002) plus sandbox egg-artifact helper. Slice 5 — prose retirement (event_prompt self-fetch fallback: coder; REVIEWER-SYNC fetch prose: documenter, per shared/prompts role ownership), docs/architecture/coordination-state.md invariant entry, ratchet test; #3046 event_prompt.py overlap with slice 1 handled by chain serialization. Slice 6 — bounded durability per HITL Q3: auto→memory fallback = error-level log + degraded health flag, explicit memory = warning, no change to auto semantics; Redis restart-semantics test distinguishing the designed _clear_concurrent_state wipe from accidental mid-phase loss. Draft validated locally: parse_plan success, 0 warnings; validate_plan_preflight OK; every task's files verified writable by its role via check_file_restriction.
